evidence.snippet: Our Rbp4-deficient mice accumulated retinol in the liver but it was undetectable in the serum, indicating an inverse relation between serum and liver retinol levels.

nodes.description: Empirical, and the evidence for it is genuinely mixed rather than merely thin. The rationale is mass action: enough retinol in the gut may reach tissues by carrier-independent routes even with no RBP4. Against that sits the founding family's dose-response test, in which serum retinol did not rise at all on oral loading - the single most direct human measurement of whether this strategy raises circulating substrate, and it was negative. The supporting rescue result comes from Stra6-null mice, which model the receptor at the far side of the same axis, not RBP4 deficiency itself.

evidence.reference_title: STRA6 is critical for cellular vitamin A uptake and homeostasis.
evidence.snippet: under conditions mimicking vitamin A excess and deficiency, our analyses revealed that STRA6-mediated vitamin A uptake is a regulated process mandatory for ocular vitamin A uptake when RBP4 constitutes the only transport mode in vitamin A deficiency

nodes.description: Without 11-cis-retinal, rod visual pigment cannot be regenerated after bleaching. This is the step that produces the disease's first and most characteristic symptom, and it is functional before it is degenerative - dark-adaptation thresholds rise while photoreceptors are still present.

evidence.snippet: Retinitis Pigmentosa (RP) is a common form of retinal degeneration characterized by photoreceptor degeneration and retinal pigment epithelium (RPE) atrophy causing loss of visual field and acuities.

nodes.description: The strain that made the model informative. Rbp4-null mice on a mixed 129xC57BL/6J background have only a transient b-wave deficit that recovers by 24 weeks; moving the same null onto pure C57BL/6 produced a severe, non-recovering phenotype. Background choice, not the null itself, is what separates a model that recapitulates the human disease from one that appears to outgrow it.
